question: Will Ali Khamenei cease to be supreme leader of Iran before April 1, 2026?
summary: Death of Ayatollah Khamenei confirmed by multiple outlets on Feb 28, 2026, implying he ceased to be supreme leader before Apr 1, 2026.
The event removes the main uncertainty; succession timing becomes the only remaining variable, but exit has occurred.
The ensemble forecast (93%) underestimates the risk after new information; probability should be near-certain for the window.
Objections raised plausibly about acceleration of succession support why the likelihood is not zero, but do not negate the exit.

justification.critique_assessment: Objections correctly highlight acceleration pathways but the confirmed death makes the exit effectively certain within the window, so the objections raise plausible speed but do not undermine the outcome.
justification.adjustment: Adjusted upward from 0.93 to 0.99 due to verified death before the horizon; range reflects uncertainty about timing of formal succession post-exit.

forecasts.reference-class: long-tenured, lifetime-appointment heads of state (Iran's Supreme Leader and comparable autocrats) whose exits are typically through death or extraordinary political change; base-rate anchored to age-related mortality and historical exit dynamics for such officeholders.

This pushes the probability of ceasing to be supreme leader within the window to near certainty, well above the prior ensemble average, with the main remaining question being when a formal successor is installed.
